provenance.note: Derived tool contracts only; endpoint/host/session identifiers omitted

path.description: The tag path to get diagnostic info from. Paths follow a [Tag Provider]tag/path format, tag provider is required.

paths.description: One or more tag paths to read. Paths follow the format [providerName]path/to/tag.

path.description: Filters for tags with a matching name. Paths follow a [Tag Provider]tag/path format. Supports the * character as a wildcard, tag provider is required.

quality.description: Filters for tags with a matching quality

maxResults.description: Limit the number of returned matching results.  Maximum supported response size is 500 elements.

filters.description: The filters that can be applied to the queried tag paths

continuationPoint.description: The continuation point from a previous query.  If the number of results exceed the maxResults limit then a continuationPoint is returned so that subsequent calls can return the remaining elements.
